purpose: GW001 counts by competition_key for Results and Match Report
sql: SELECT competition_key, SUM(results_count) AS results_count, SUM(match_report_count) AS match_report_count FROM (SELECT competition_key, COUNT(*) AS results_count, 0 AS match_report_count FROM `GW001_IMC Results` GROUP BY competition_key UNION ALL SELECT competition_key, 0 AS results_count, COUNT(*) AS match_report_count FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` GROUP BY competition_key) x GROUP BY competition_key ORDER BY competition_key
